stem_book: (One or more than one option may be correct) Which one is not correct for a cyclic process as shown in the figure? [circular loop on a P (kPa) – V (m³) plot, spanning P = 10 to 30 kPa and V = 10 to 30 m³] (a) dU = 0 (b) q = −w (c) q = 314 J (d) w = 31.4 J
correct_answer: c, d (q = 314 J and w = 31.4 J are not correct)
reason: Printed key abc marks dU = 0 and q = −w as 'not correct', but both hold for any cycle; |q| = |w| = π(10 kPa)(10 m³) = 3.14×10⁵ J, so only (c) and (d) are not correct.
